sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_namespace" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "model_year" INTEGER NULL, "calibration_metadata_json" TEXT NULL, "baseline_metadata_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trips" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "start_wall_time_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_wall_time_micros" INTEGER NULL, "start_elapsed_nanos" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_elapsed_nanos" INTEGER NULL, "duration_millis" INTEGER NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NULL, "completion_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "recovery_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "telemetry_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scoring_version" TEXT NULL, "event_engine_version" TEXT NULL, "ml_model_refs_json" TEXT NULL, "integrity_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "telemetry_confidence" REAL NULL, "telemetry_quality_summary_json" TEXT NULL, "cloud_sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (end_wall_time_micros IS NULL OR end_wall_time_micros >= start_wall_time_micros), CHECK (end_elapsed_nanos IS NULL OR end_elapsed_nanos >= start_elapsed_nanos), CHECK (duration_millis IS NULL OR duration_millis >= 0), CHECK (distance_meters IS NULL OR distance_meters >= 0), CHECK (telemetry_schema_version > 0), CHECK (telemetry_confidence IS NULL OR (telemetry_confidence >= 0 AND telemetry_confidence <= 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_chunks" ("trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "storage_reference" TEXT NOT NULL, "encoding_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_elapsed_nanos" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_elapsed_nanos" INTEGER NOT NULL, "channel_sample_counts_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "compression" TEXT NOT NULL, "atomic_write_strategy" TEXT NOT NULL, "checksum_algorithm" TEXT NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "write_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("trip_id", "sequence"), CHECK (sequence >= 0), CHECK (encoding_version > 0), CHECK (end_elapsed_nanos >= start_elapsed_nanos), CHECK (byte_length >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_elapsed_nanos" INTEGER NOT NULL, "peak_elapsed_nanos" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_elapsed_nanos" INTEGER NOT NULL, "severity" REAL NOT NULL, "severity_calibration_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL, "quality_flags_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_measurements_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_evidence_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "ml_evidence_json" TEXT NULL, "context_tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (peak_elapsed_nanos >= start_elapsed_nanos), CHECK (end_elapsed_nanos >= peak_elapsed_nanos), CHECK (severity >= 0 AND severity <= 1), CHECK (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "driver_baselines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_namespace" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "lifecycle_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_statistics_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "baseline_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scoring_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "valid_trip_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "window_start_wall_time_micros" INTEGER NULL, "window_end_wall_time_micros" INTEGER NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (baseline_schema_version > 0), CHECK (valid_trip_count >= 0), CHECK (confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)), CHECK (window_start_wall_time_micros IS NULL OR window_end_wall_time_micros IS NULL OR window_end_wall_time_micros >= window_start_wall_time_micros));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_scores" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "score_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scoring_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_values_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "overall_score" REAL NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "eligibility_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "audit_contributions_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "baseline_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES driver_baselines (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "model_versions_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (score_schema_version > 0), CHECK (overall_score IS NULL OR (overall_score >= 0 AND overall_score <= 100)), CHECK (confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_queue" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "operation_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_attempt_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"), CHECK (entity_version >= 0), CHECK (attempt_count >= 0));
CREATE INDEX trips_vehicle_start ON trips (vehicle_id, start_wall_time_micros)
CREATE INDEX trip_events_trip_start ON trip_events (trip_id, start_elapsed_nanos)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX trip_scores_trip_version ON trip_scores (trip_id, score_schema_version, scoring_version)
CREATE INDEX driver_baselines_owner_vehicle ON driver_baselines (owner_namespace, vehicle_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sync_queue_idempotency_key ON sync_queue (idempotency_key)
CREATE INDEX sync_queue_state_next_attempt ON sync_queue (state, next_attempt_at_micros)
